title: 来襲！ スペース野球ゾンビ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urk. I was supposed to be training today, but I couldn't resist the urge to come here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But that trailer for the highly anticipated Attack of the Spaceball Zombies is not fair!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How can there be zombies in space?! And why are they playing baseball on a spaceship?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There is no way I can focus on training with all of these questions in my head!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! One student ticket, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-what an astounding story… It truly delivered on the grand spectacle they advertised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To think that without that last home run, Earth would have fallen into the hands of the spaceball zombies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: From now on, every time I look at the sky, I will think of that ball disappearing into Mars.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Coming out on a weekday, the movie theater was nice and quiet. I could make a habit of this.
